author.name: Model Monica
author.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

challenge.name: The Override Blind Spot
challenge.description: Store managers are overriding order suggestions at an alarming rate because they cannot verify if the model behind them is the one they tested. #model_monica# wants a fully automated registry to ensure every deployment is traceable and reproducible. #requirements_reuben# has a red line: no model enters the registry without a manual, documented review of its evaluation metrics to ensure compliance, so he insists on keeping the process manual.

output.content: I need the hand over from model evaluation to the registry to be fully automated. Right now, someone has to copy metrics by hand, and that is a slow, error prone step that slows down our iteration cycle. I want the evaluation results to flow directly into the registry the moment a model finishes training. This will make every deployment traceable and reproducible without waiting for a human to intervene. The more seamless this pipeline becomes, the faster we can ship new versions and verify that the model on the shelf is the one we tested. I am asking for this to be a standard, automated part of our workflow so we can stop losing time to manual data entry.
output.reclassify_reason: The statement expresses a need for automation to improve speed and traceability, and doing more than asked (e.g., adding real-time monitoring or advanced validation) would further satisfy the desire for a seamless, fast pipeline.
